about: The founder video edit (Script C). One entry per line. 'take' is the file in marketing/video/raw/ (your best take of that line). 'cutaway' swaps the picture for footage while your voice keeps playing: a recorded scene (rain, shatter, names) or a still (assets/...). 'trim' is [in, out] seconds; leave it out and the silence at each end is cut automatically. Delete a line to drop it (the 30 s cut drops 7 and 8).

lines.caption: I'M SELLING ONE LAMBORGHINI TO AS MANY PEOPLE AS WANT IT.
IT'S FIFTY DOLLARS. YOU GET A KEY.
THERE'S NO LIMIT. IF A HUNDRED THOUSAND PEOPLE BUY ONE, A HUNDRED THOUSAND PEOPLE OWN IT.
EVERY NEW OWNER MAKES THE CAR MORE OWNED, AND EVERY OWNER LESS OF AN OWNER.
YOU CAN'T DRIVE IT. THE KEY DOESN'T START IT.
YOUR NAME GOES ON THE CAR. AT 6,000 OWNERS, IT'S ABOUT 18 MM TALL.
IT ISN'T AN INVESTMENT. IT'S WORSE. IT'S ART.
I WANTED TO KNOW WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS WHEN EVERYBODY HAS IT.
IF 6,000 PEOPLE DON'T BUY A KEY BY DEC 9, EVERYONE GETS THEIR MONEY BACK, AND THE CAR STAYS A PICTURE.
